title: Intrusion Inc. to Present at the Sidoti Micro Cap Investor Conference
summary: PLANO, TX / ACCESS Newswire / May 15, 2026 / Intrusion Inc. (NASDAQ:INTZ) ("Intrusion" or the "Company"), a leader in cyberattack prevention solutions, announced today that Tony Scott, CEO, will present and host one-on-one meetings with investors at the Sidoti Micro Cap Conference on May 20, 2026. Management will hold a formal presentation on May 20 at 1:45 p.m. EDT and will host investor meetings throughout the day. A live webcast of the presentation can be accessed here , or in the "Events" section of the Intrusion investor relations website. To register for the presentation or one-on-ones, visit www.sidoti.com/events . Registration is free and you don't need to be a Sidoti client. About Intrusion Inc. Intrusion Inc. is a cybersecurity company based in Plano, Texas, specializing in advanced threat intelligence.
